response.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "upwards of 1 point" means strictly more than 1 point (points > 1), using the season-to-date running total in driverStandings.points. Each standings row counts equally. NULL wins are excluded, and the average is not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 1 point" read as at least 1 point (points >= 1).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL;
